title: 第一卷 正文第25章 演武台第一卷 正文第26章 赌斗
content_zh:
“贵宾请便。”方涛道。
楚凌天右手一挥，将四个木盒收入储物玉佩，然后转身离开珍宝阁。
两个时辰后，楚凌天回到星辰学宫，来到任务阁第一层交任务。
孙长老看到楚凌天毫发无损的回来，便已经十分震惊。当他看到楚凌天取出的铁背狼尸体和黑线蟒妖丹后，更是瞪大眼睛，露出不敢置信之色。
“你竟然真的完成了两个三级任务？”
楚凌天笑了笑：“孙长老，是不是该把任务奖励发放给我了。”
回过神儿的孙长老，接过楚凌天的身份令牌，将任务记录改为完成，然后将八十五学分存入令牌当中。
“多谢孙长老。”楚凌天拱手道。
孙长老问道：“你叫什么名字？”
楚凌天回答道：“弟子名叫楚凌天。”
孙长老点了点头：“能完成两个三级外门任务，你的实力至少可以排进这届新生的前三名。好好努力，希望你能在新生大比中取得第一。”
“多谢孙长老的鼓励。”楚凌天感谢道。
接过身份令牌后，楚凌天离开任务阁，去了学分堂，想要了解一下学分的价值。
学分堂的布置和任务阁相似，都是上下三层，对应着普通外门弟子、精英外门弟子和潜龙榜上的强者。
楚凌天走进学分堂第一层，一块巨大的石板映入眼帘。
石板上写着密密麻麻的字，正是学分兑换清单。
“黄阶高级武技《通背金刚拳》，五十学分。”
“黄阶高阶武技《伏魔掌》，六十学分。”
“玄气丹一瓶，二十学分。”
“灵武丹一瓶，一百学分。”

“一品高阶灵器青钢剑，一百五十学分。”
“一品高阶灵器紫元刀，一百六十学分。”
……
楚凌天看着学分兑换清单，心中估算道：“一学分大概相当于五百两银子。”
虽然在购买力上，一学分相当于五百两银子。但星辰学宫作为赤炎帝国三大学宫之一，底蕴深厚。
相比外面的商行，学分堂内兑换的宝物品质会更高，兑换的功法、武技，威力也会更强。
“以后可以多完成一些任务，来学分堂兑换宝物。”楚凌天心中暗道。
了解完学分的价值后，楚凌天离开学分堂，准备返回宿舍，将买来的《风魂阵》布下。
但他刚走到宿舍门口，还没来得及打开院门，就听到身后传来一道充满怨毒的声音。
“楚凌天，立刻给本少跪下磕头认错，并扇自己十记耳光。本少可以大发慈悲，饶你一条狗命！”
楚凌天转头望去，就看到三道人影，气势汹汹地朝他走来。
来人正是叶飞宇和他的两个狗腿子。
半个月前，叶飞宇被楚凌天击败后，带着满腔的怒火投入到修炼当中。
content_en:
"Dear guest, please excuse me," Fang Tao said.
Chu Lingtian waved his right hand, put the four wooden boxes into the storage jade pendant, then turned and left the Treasure Pavilion.
Two hours later, Chu Lingtian returned to Xingchen Academy and went to the first floor of the Mission Pavilion to hand in the mission.
Elder Sun was shocked when he saw Chu Lingtian coming back unscathed. When he saw the iron-backed wolf corpse and the black-threaded python demon pill that Chu Lingtian took out, his eyes widened in disbelief.
"You actually completed two level three missions?"
Chu Lingtian smiled: "Elder Sun, is it time to give me the mission reward?"
After coming back to his senses, Elder Sun took Chu Lingtian's identity token, changed the mission record to Complete, and then stored the eighty-five credits into the token.
"Thank you, Elder Sun." Chu Lingtian said with cupped hands.
Elder Sun asked: "What is your name?"
Chu Lingtian replied: "The disciple's name is Chu Lingtian."
Elder Sun nodded: "If you can complete two third-level outer sect tasks, your strength can at least rank among the top three freshmen in this class. Work hard, and I hope you can get first place in the freshmen competition."
"Thank you, Elder Sun, for your encouragement." Chu Lingtian thanked him.
After receiving the identity token, Chu Lingtian left the mission pavilion and went to the credit hall to understand the value of the credits.
The layout of the branch hall is similar to that of the mission pavilion, with three floors above and below, corresponding to ordinary outer disciples, elite outer disciples and strong men on the Hidden Dragon Ranking.
When Chu Lingtian walked into the first floor of the branch hall, a huge stone slab came into view.
There are dense words written on the slate, which is the credit redemption list.
"The Huang-level advanced martial art "Tongbei Vajra Fist", fifty credits."
"The Huang-level high-level martial skill "Devil's Palm", sixty credits."
"One bottle of Xuanqi Pill, twenty credits."
"One bottle of Lingwu Pill, one hundred credits."
"First-grade high-level spiritual weapon Qinggang Sword, one hundred and fifty credits."
"First-grade high-level spiritual weapon Ziyuan Dao, one hundred and sixty credits."
…
Chu Lingtian looked at the credit redemption list and estimated in his mind: "One credit is equivalent to about five hundred taels of silver."
Although in terms of purchasing power, one credit is equivalent to five hundred taels of silver. However, as one of the three academic palaces in the Chiyan Empire, Star Academy has a profound foundation.
Compared with outside trading houses, the treasures exchanged in the branch hall will be of higher quality, and the exercises and martial arts exchanged will be more powerful.
"In the future, you can complete more tasks and come to the branch hall to exchange for treasures." Chu Lingtian thought to himself.
After understanding the value of the credits, Chu Lingtian left the credit hall and prepared to return to the dormitory to lay out the "Wind Soul Array" he bought.
But as soon as he reached the door of the dormitory and before he could open the courtyard door, he heard a voice full of resentment coming from behind him.
"Chu Lingtian, immediately kneel down and kowtow to admit your mistake, and slap yourself ten times. I can show mercy and spare your life!"
Chu Lingtian turned around and saw three figures walking towards him menacingly.
The visitors were none other than Ye Feiyu and his two henchmen.
Half a month ago, after Ye Feiyu was defeated by Chu Lingtian, he devoted himself to training with full anger.
